findings.evidence: `code/TauCeti/Analysis/Contour/Residue.lean:93-95` has both assumptions; Mathlib provides `meromorphicAt_of_meromorphicOrderAt_ne_zero` at `mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/Meromorphic/Order.lean:57`, and `hord` makes the order nonzero.
findings.fix: Use the signature `(hord : meromorphicOrderAt f z₀ = -1) : residue f z₀ = meromorphicTrailingCoeffAt f z₀` and derive `hf` internally, e.g. from `meromorphicAt_of_meromorphicOrderAt_ne_zero (by rw [hord]; norm_num)`.
findings.issue: `residue_eq_meromorphicTrailingCoeffAt_of_order_eq_neg_one` assumes both `hf : MeromorphicAt f z₀` and `hord : meromorphicOrderAt f z₀ = -1`, but `hord` already implies meromorphicity.

summary: The simple-pole API carries a redundant meromorphicity assumption; the order hypothesis already gives it. Drop the stronger assumption so downstream users can rewrite from the natural simple-pole signature alone.
